verdict.rationale: Sentry's Alerts system supports rule-based triggers with routing to Slack, tickets, and webhooks (sentry-docs-3, sentry-docs-21, sentry-docs-32), and it can ingest OTel traces/logs plus errors and performance data as telemetry sources (sentry-docs-8, sentry-docs-9, sentry-docs-25). However, the evidence pack lacks explicit documentation of issue-grouping rules or alert-silencing/mute/snooze mechanisms, both key parts of the story. Missing for 10: explicit grouping configuration for alerts, explicit silencing/snoozing/mute functionality, and any independent corroboration of alert reliability at scale.
